capabilities.avoid_when: Only raw S3TC/DXT block decoding without a DDS header is needed (use formatkit_pixel::dxt).

capabilities.path: formatkit_patch::ips::{Patch, Record, RecordData, ApplyOptions, OverlapPolicy, GrowthPolicy, Validation, create}
capabilities.summary: IPS binary patch parsing, validation, creation, serialization, and policy-controlled application.
capabilities.use_when: Reading, creating, or applying IPS patches with explicit overlap, growth, and output-size policies.
capabilities.avoid_when: Patch requires source/target CRC-32 verification or delta-copy encoding (use bps or ups).

capabilities.summary: BPS (Beat Patching System) binary patch parsing, CRC-32 verification, creation, and application.
capabilities.use_when: Applying or creating size-changing delta patches with source, target, and patch CRC-32 integrity checks.
capabilities.avoid_when: Target workflow requires IPS or XOR-based UPS patches.

capabilities.summary: UPS XOR-based binary patch parsing, CRC-32 verification, creation, and reversible application.
capabilities.use_when: Applying or creating XOR-chunk UPS patches with source/target/patch CRC-32 verification.
capabilities.avoid_when: Delta-copy compression is needed for shifted data (use bps).

capabilities.summary: Bijective variable-length integer (varint) encoding and decoding used by BPS and UPS patches.
capabilities.use_when: Encoding or decoding bijective base-128 variable-length integers.
capabilities.avoid_when: Standard LEB128 or VLQ encoding is required (bijective VLI adds +1 per continuation byte).

capabilities.path: formatkit_archive::{extract, ExtractionMode, ExtractionReceipt, select_index, select_name, SelectionError}
capabilities.summary: Format-neutral member selection and bounded streaming extraction over any IndexedNamespace.
capabilities.use_when: Selecting archive members by index or exact display name and streaming stored or decoded content to a Write sink.
capabilities.avoid_when: You need recursive nested-archive traversal (use walk).

capabilities.summary: Shared mounting sequence for paired index-plus-data archives whose members are stored byte ranges.
capabilities.use_when: Mounting an archive split across an index file and a companion data file with bounded index I/O and source revalidation.
capabilities.avoid_when: Archive is self-contained in a single source (build StoredRangeNamespace directly).

capabilities.path: formatkit_archive::{walk, WalkOptions, WalkEvent, WalkControl, Resolver, Resolution, ResolutionVisitor}
capabilities.summary: Depth-bounded, WorkBudget-accounted recursive traversal over nested mounted namespaces with owner-injected resolution.
capabilities.use_when: Walking nested archives/containers while enforcing depth, node, member, and cancellation limits.
capabilities.avoid_when: Only inspecting top-level entries of a single namespace (iterate namespace.entries()).

capabilities.summary: Open, typed format, category, and method identities without a closed central enum.
capabilities.use_when: Assigning stable, typed identities to formats in a new kit.
capabilities.avoid_when: Never hardcode a closed central enum across crates when FormatId suffices.

capabilities.summary: Owner-declared format detection probes, precedence, extension tie-breakers, and capability metadata.
capabilities.use_when: Declaring how a format is identified and what capabilities its owner implements.
capabilities.avoid_when: Avoid CompatibilityRecognitionRule in greenfield kits; use FormatDescriptor directly.

capabilities.summary: Deterministic content-first format identification catalog with path-hint tie-breaking.
capabilities.use_when: Identifying unknown inputs deterministically across an explicitly composed set of FormatDescriptors.
capabilities.avoid_when: Composing full executable modules (build ModuleCatalog in formatkit-runtime and call catalog.formats().identify()).

capabilities.path: formatkit_catalog::{LeafOperationProvider, LeafOperationContract, LeafOperationCatalog, LeafDecodeRequest, LeafDecodeLimits, LeafOutput, LeafOutputKind}
capabilities.summary: Typed contracts and dispatch catalog for decoded leaf formats (images, PCM audio, etc.).
capabilities.use_when: Exposing a leaf format decoder (image, audio) through ModuleCatalog.
capabilities.avoid_when: Format is an archive or container with child entries (use NamespaceProvider).

capabilities.path: formatkit_catalog::{NamespaceProvider, NamespaceMountContract, RoleBoundNamespaceProvider, RoleBoundNamespaceContract, NamespaceSemantics, WorkMountedNamespace}
capabilities.summary: Typed mount contracts and providers for single-source, paired, and role-bound archive namespaces.
capabilities.use_when: Registering a container or archive mounter in ModuleCatalog.
capabilities.avoid_when: Format is a leaf object with no child entries (use LeafOperationProvider).

capabilities.summary: Canonical role-based input schemas and bound input validation for multi-source and selector-driven operations.
capabilities.use_when: Declaring required/optional source roles and selectors for strict ModuleOperation entries.
capabilities.avoid_when: Low-level library helpers that take a direct &[u8] or &dyn RangeSource.

capabilities.path: formatkit_catalog::{WriterContract, ReproductionContract, EditContract, AuthoringContract, EditMode, OperationScope}
capabilities.summary: Proof-backed writer contracts declaring reproduction, in-place/repack editing, and authoring guarantees.
capabilities.use_when: Attaching verified write/edit/round-trip guarantees to a FormatModule.
capabilities.avoid_when: Format is currently read-only.

capabilities.summary: Migration-only recognition scaffolding for bridging legacy detectors during incremental strict-module adoption.
capabilities.use_when: Migrating an existing legacy detector incrementally toward strict FormatModule rows.
capabilities.avoid_when: Building a greenfield kit; always use FormatDescriptor and ModuleState::Strict.

capabilities.path: formatkit_runtime::{FormatModule, ModuleState, ModuleOperation, OperationId, OperationCapabilities, ExistingExecutableOperation, ModuleCatalog, ResidentWriterProvider, ResidentWriteOutput}
capabilities.summary: Explicit per-format module composition kernel validating descriptors, contracts, capabilities, and strict operation dispatch.
capabilities.use_when: Composing a kit's selected format modules into a validated detection, leaf-decode, namespace-mount, and writer runtime.
capabilities.avoid_when: A standalone single-format crate that does not need cross-format composition.

capabilities.path: formatkit_corpus::{dir, subdir, file, samples, samples_all, first, is_sample_name}
capabilities.summary: Explicit-root external corpus discovery gated on FORMATKIT_CORPUS_DIR and safe-runner lock enforcement.
capabilities.use_when: Locating external real-world test samples without hardcoding paths or bundling sample bytes.
capabilities.avoid_when: Unit tests using synthetic in-memory fixtures.

capabilities.path: formatkit_corpus_test::{Digest, Registry, Args, run_dir, run_all, run_root, archive_digest, hash_bytes, roundtrip_ok}
capabilities.summary: Specification-driven golden digest test harness comparing computed JSON digests against external spec.json files.
capabilities.use_when: Validating parsers, decoders, and round-trips against external real-world corpora with frozen JSON expectations.
capabilities.avoid_when: Ordinary synthetic unit tests.

capabilities.path: formatkit_corpus_test::compress_oracle::{load_pairs, run, run_from_corpus, diff, Pair, Ledger, Outcome}
capabilities.summary: Oracle test runner for verifying compression/decompression codec pairs against external corpus fixtures.
capabilities.use_when: Verifying a compression codec against external compressed/decompressed golden pairs.
capabilities.avoid_when: Testing non-codec formats (use Digest + Registry).

capabilities.summary: Root-manifest driven corpus runner for evaluating multi-format collections declared in manifest.json.
capabilities.use_when: Running corpus verification driven by a top-level manifest.json instead of per-directory spec.json files.
capabilities.avoid_when: Simple per-format subdirectory spec.json suites (use run_dir/run_all).

capabilities.summary: SHA-256-sealed corpus package verification with bounded case admission and path validation.
capabilities.use_when: Enforcing cryptographic immutability of a frozen external corpus manifest before running validation.
capabilities.avoid_when: Unsealed development corpora.
